subject.title: feat(cli): improve editor handoffs for agents and humans

question: Should `crabbox/editor-handoff/v1` be accepted now as Crabbox's supported automation contract for editor handoffs?
rationale: Tests can verify serialization, but they cannot decide whether these exact fields, omission rules, and lifecycle semantics are the long-term public interface maintainers want to support.

options.title: Approve v1 after proof
options.body: Accept the proposed contract once a live terminal run verifies stream separation and foreground lifecycle behavior.

options.title: Mark the contract experimental
options.body: Keep the automation mode but avoid a stable v1 promise until additional editors and consumers validate the shape.

options.title: Keep only human improvements
options.body: Land the terminal-output refinements while deferring the machine-readable interface to a separately designed contract.

recommendation.title: Approve v1 after proof
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed contract once a live terminal run verifies stream separation and foreground lifecycle behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and merged the generalized editor-handoff architecture that defines this contract's product boundary.
